name: skeleton
purpose: Use Skeleton when a region with a known shape (text, table rows, cards, avatars) is still loading — the default answer to 'show a loading state'. For an inline busy mark use Spinner, for work with a measurable amount use Progress, and for a generative AI answer use ResponseLoading. A loading placeholder that reserves the space of content while it loads, gently pulsing to signal activity. Use it in place of text lines, media, or avatars during fetches; unlike `status-indicator` (which communicates a settled state) the skeleton is a transient, decorative stand-in. Two geometries cover the common cases: a rounded rectangular block (`rectangle`) and a `circle` (for avatars / icons).
useWhen: Content is loading and its final layout is known: text lines, cards, media blocks.
avoidWhen: The duration is unknown and no layout is reserved → use `progress` with `indeterminate`, or `spinner`.
Rows in a data-driven `table` → use the `table` `loading` prop, which renders aligned skeleton rows.
Loading finished with no data → use `empty-state`.
A settled state such as Active or Failed → use `status-indicator`.
related: `progress` — measured or indeterminate progress of a task, not a placeholder.
`spinner` — compact busy glyph for buttons and inline status.
`empty-state` — what replaces the skeleton when the request returns nothing.
`table` — its `loading` prop renders skeleton rows for you.
bestPractices: Size each skeleton like the content it stands in for (`width`, `height`) so nothing shifts when the data arrives.
For `variant="circle"`, set `width` and `height` to the same value.
The skeleton is `aria-hidden`. Mark the container you own with `aria-busy="true"` while it loads.
Keep `animated` on (the default). The shimmer already turns off under reduced motion; use `:animated="false"` only for static captures.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Geometry: a rounded rectangular block (`rectangle`) or a circle.

props.name: width
props.doc: CSS width (any length); a rectangle never grows past its container.

props.name: height
props.doc: CSS height (any length); for a circle, set equal to `width`.

props.name: animated
props.doc: Shimmer while loading; suppressed under reduced motion.
